openaiSpec.name: search
openaiSpec.description:
Quick web search using Perplexity sonar model (30s timeout). Best for: current prices, quick fact checks, news, recent regulatory updates. Returns content + structured citations (title, URL, snippet) + metadata.

Parameters:
- query (required): Search query - be specific and descriptive for best results
- search_focus (optional): general_search|product_specific|technical_how_to|current_events|factual_verification|market_prices|company_research
- domain_filter (optional): Array of domains to allowlist (e.g. ["gesetze-im-internet.de"]) or denylist (prefix with "-", e.g. ["-reddit.com"]). Max 20.
- recency_filter (optional): hour|day|week|month|year

query.description: Search query. Be specific and descriptive - the query drives the web search, not the system prompt.

domain_filter.description: Domain allowlist (e.g. ["gesetze-im-internet.de"]) or denylist (prefix with "-", e.g. ["-reddit.com"]). Max 20.

openaiSpec.name: research
openaiSpec.description:
Deep reasoning search using Perplexity sonar-reasoning-pro (180s timeout). Best for: multi-step analysis, legal interpretation, cross-jurisdictional comparison, feasibility studies. Returns content + structured citations + metadata.

Parameters same as search, plus:
- search_focus adds 'company_research' for business intelligence

query.description: Research query. Be specific - the query drives web search.

pluginFunctions.name: deep_research

openaiSpec.name: deep_research
openaiSpec.description:
Exhaustive research using Perplexity sonar-deep-research (600s timeout). Best for: comprehensive legal opinions, exhaustive regulatory analysis, literature synthesis, multi-source reports. Returns content + structured citations + metadata.

Note: This function can take several minutes and costs more. Use for high-stakes research only.

query.description: Deep research query. Be specific and comprehensive.

dynamicContextEndpoints.name: search guidance
dynamicContextEndpoints.staticContent: Use the search tool for quick factual queries: current prices, fact checks, news, recent regulatory updates. It uses the fast sonar model (30s). For complex analysis or multi-step reasoning, use research instead. For exhaustive reports, use deep_research. After receiving results, ALWAYS list all citations and sources from the search_results array so the user can verify. Use domain_filter to restrict to authoritative sources (e.g. ["gesetze-im-internet.de"] for legal, ["arxiv.org"] for academic). Use recency_filter for time-sensitive queries (e.g. "day" for current prices).

dynamicContextEndpoints.name: research guidance
dynamicContextEndpoints.staticContent: Use the research tool for multi-step reasoning: legal interpretation, cross-jurisdictional comparison, feasibility studies, technical analysis. It uses sonar-reasoning-pro (180s). For quick facts, use search instead. For exhaustive multi-source reports, use deep_research. After receiving results, ALWAYS list all citations and sources from the search_results array so the user can verify. Use domain_filter for authoritative sources. Use search_focus to optimize results (e.g. factual_verification for legal, market_prices for financial).

dynamicContextEndpoints.name: deep_research guidance
dynamicContextEndpoints.staticContent: Use the deep_research tool for exhaustive, comprehensive research: legal opinions, regulatory analysis, literature synthesis, multi-source reports. It uses sonar-deep-research (600s, can take several minutes). Use ONLY for high-stakes research where thoroughness matters more than speed. For quick queries use search, for analysis use research. After receiving results, ALWAYS list all citations and sources from the search_results array so the user can verify. Use domain_filter to restrict to authoritative sources.
